definitions.explanation: A substance that flows freely and has no fixed shape, one of the three states of matter.

examples.japanese: {水|みず}は{液体|えきたい}の{一種|いっしゅ}だ。
examples.english: Water is a type of liquid.

examples.japanese: この{液体|えきたい}は{何|なん}ですか。
{液体|えきたい}を{容器|ようき}に{入|い}れてください。
examples.english: Please put the liquid in the container.

notes:
SCIENTIFIC CONTEXT: One of the three states of matter along with {固体|こたい} (solid) and {気体|きたい} (gas).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{液体|えきたい}{窒素|ちっそ} (liquid nitrogen)
・{液体|えきたい}{燃料|ねんりょう} (liquid fuel)
・{液体|えきたい}{洗剤|せんざい} (liquid detergent)
